tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search Kareverse's elder-care services in Bangalore by need (for example 'hospital visit', 'injection at home', 'night caretaker', 'physiotherapy after stroke'). Returns matching services with price, Care Plan member price and page URL. Leave query empty to list a category.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full details of one Kareverse service by id (from search_services): what is included and not included, price options, notice needed, FAQs and how to book.

tools.name: get_care_plan
tools.description: The monthly Kareverse Care Plan (a dedicated Care Manager, monthly home visit, weekly check-in, 24/7 emergency support): what it includes, monthly/quarterly/annual prices, and condition programmes such as dementia and Parkinson's care.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether Kareverse covers a locality or pincode in Bangalore (e.g. 'Whitefield', 'HSR Layout', '560066'), or list all service areas when locality is empty.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Kareverse's published guides for families caring for elderly parents (costs, caretakers, dementia, falls, hospital discharge, NRI care, Karnataka schemes). Returns titles, summaries and URLs.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Kareverse's phone/WhatsApp, email, working hours and office address, plus the service categories.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Record a callback request for the Kareverse team. The result contains a WhatsApp link the person must open and send to confirm; Kareverse only contacts people who confirm. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_services, search_guides, get_contact_info · Private data: get_contact_info, submit_enquiry · Public sink: get_contact_info, submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_services, search_guides, get_contact_info · Private data: get_contact_info, submit_enquiry · Public sink: get_contact_info, submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
